枚举类 TowerWarsMob

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<TowerWarsMob>
top.brmc.bukkitplatform.towerwars.mob.TowerWarsMob
所有已实现的接口:
Serializable, Comparable<TowerWarsMob>, Constable
public enum TowerWarsMob extends Enum<TowerWarsMob>
28 种 TowerWars 怪物定义(14 个基础形态 + 14 个进阶形态). 严格遵照 MythicMobs 配置文件及原版玩法数值标准.
